title: Projection tensor action with separate target images
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category, with monoidal preadditivity, a functorial flat resolution, and flat-preserving inverse image. Let f:X -> Y be a separated locally finite-type quasi-compact scheme morphism and c a compactification. Write T_X,T_Y for the specified derived tensors, U for the derived inverse image, F for compact support through c, P(k,q) for projectionTensorCoordinateComponent of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], and alpha for the canonical action associator from [lem-pur-finite-projection-action-laws]. For arbitrary derived sheaves k on X and q,N on Y, the composite tensor(P(k,q),1_N);P(T_X(k,Uq),N) equals alpha_Y(Fk,q,N);P(k,T_Y(q,N));F(T_X(k,mu_f(q,N)));F(alpha_X(k,Uq,UN).inverse), where mu_f is the canonical pullback/tensor comparison. The two target images under F are separate. These are the actual canonical maps of [def-exchange-projection], without invertibility of a projection being assumed.

proof.text: Use the already proved general coefficient-category library declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.genericProjectionAction_compactification in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteProjectionActionLaws (the module realizing [lem-pur-finite-projection-action-laws]). Its actual Lean signature quantifies over the arbitrary coefficient category A and the schemes here; no extension of the narrower paper specialization is assumed. Reverse its equation and unfold projectionTensorCoordinateComponent.

Functor.map_comp for F separates its image of the tensor comparison followed by the inverse target associator. Compose this equality with the two preceding maps; this is precisely the displayed equation. The generic private splitProjectionActionImage lemma proves this elementary categorical rewriting before specialization.
